name: Luxembourg
snapshot: Europe's richest country per head, a Grand Duchy that welcomed a new monarch, Grand Duke Guillaume, in October 2025.
culture: Luxembourgers speak Luxembourgish, French and German, and most also speak English; nearly half the residents are foreigners, with a large Portuguese community. The Grand Duchy is the world's last. Schueberfouer, a fair dating to 1340, is a highlight of the year.
society: Luxembourg's finance industry, investment funds and EU institutions make it the richest country per head in the EU. More than 200,000 people cross the border from France, Belgium and Germany to work each day. It made all public transport free in 2020. Housing costs are very high.
baseline: Luc Frieden of the Christian Social People's Party has led a coalition with the Democratic Party since 2023. Grand Duke Henri abdicated in October 2025 in favour of his son Guillaume.
